lines: Each time I learn a word I don’t know
I reach out within the shadows
Yet there may be words I cannot grasp alone
Perhaps they exist
Goodbyes taste bitter
“I love you” smelled distant
This yearning cannot be likened to anything
It frightens me, yet it fills me with tenderness
Why am I crying
What answer should I give my heart
Words never simply tell
They only linger, only swell
I find myself longing to see you
Each time I learn a beautiful word
I feel I might come to hate myself
But there are words I must not turn away from
Perhaps they exist
Sorrow is cold
Thank you colors itself with warmth
Whenever I touch the intangible
Your voice echoes deep within my chest
I stopped writing halfway
A letter with no destination
Sways in the wind
To the town of the one I wish to reach
To convey the beginning’s end
To live and not to quit
So I can be proud of today for you
Why am I crying
What answer should I give my heart
Words never simply tell
They only linger, only swell
I find myself longing to see you
